default-field.title: Default TDS Section (only if TDS = Yes)

render-mode.text:
<script>
        (function(){
          function wire(){
            var tds = document.querySelector('[name="tdsApplicable"]');
            if(!tds){ return; }
            var scope = tds.closest('form') || document;
            var tdsSec = scope.querySelector('[name="defaultTdsSectionId"]');
            var msme  = scope.querySelector('[name="msmeStatusEnumId"]');
            var udyam = scope.querySelector('[name="msmeUdyamNumber"]');
            var days  = scope.querySelector('[name="paymentTermLockDays"]');
            function setOff(el, off){
              if(!el){ return; }
              el.disabled = off;
              el.style.opacity = off ? '0.5' : '';
              el.title = off ? 'Not applicable for the current selection' : '';
              if(off){ if(el.tagName === 'SELECT'){ el.selectedIndex = 0; } el.value = ''; }
            }
            function apply(){
              setOff(tdsSec, tds.value !== 'Y');
              var moff = (!msme || !msme.value || msme.value === 'Not Registered');
              setOff(udyam, moff);
              setOff(days, moff);
            }
            tds.addEventListener('change', apply);
            if(msme){ msme.addEventListener('change', apply); }
            apply();
          }
          if(document.readyState === 'loading'){ document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', wire); } else { wire(); }
        })();
        </script>
